# bash: bin: remove all git_* scripts

Retire the standalone `bin/git_*` scripts in favour of functions in `bin/lib/git/*.bash`. **Motivation:** "now I have `@` as entrypoint for it" — [bin/@](../../bin/@) sources the libraries and runs a named function, so an alias can be `!@ git-<name>` instead of `!git_<name>`; one mechanism, a simpler tree, and functions that can be unit-tested by sourcing a file ([[DOT-155]]).
